enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out mug and tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Remove tea bag. Take toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Stand up. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning walk and light jog in the local park on the public holiday (walking, no EV needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Open door. Step outside. Close door. Walk down street. Turn left. Walk to park entrance. Enter park. Walk on path. Start light jog. Jog for 10 minutes. Stop jogging. Walk to bench. Sit down. Rest. Stand up. Walk out of park. Walk back home. Open door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing into fresh clothes after exercise
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Put on fresh clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up items from floor. Place items on shelf. Pick up cushions. Fluff cushions. Place cushions on sofa. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move furniture to vacuum underneath. Vacuum under sofa. Vacuum under coffee table. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Wrap cord around vacuum cleaner. Put vacuum cleaner away. Wipe coffee table with cloth. Arrange items on coffee table. Turn off living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review physiotherapy professional development materials and rehabilitation notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Sit on chair. Open browser. Navigate to professional development website. Read articles. Take notes. Open rehabilitation notes file. Review notes. Type additional notes. Save file. Close browser. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing lunch with the induction cooker and rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash and chop vegetables and meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Wash rice. Place in rice cooker. Add water. Turn on rice cooker. Turn off rice cooker. Serve food.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and cleaning up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Pick up bowl. Pick up chopsticks. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Rinse bowl. Rinse chopsticks. Place dishes in dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Adjust cushion. Lie down on sofa. Watch TV. Sit up. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Shopping for groceries and household supplies at the local supermarket (walking/bus, no EV needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Get off bus. Walk to supermarket. Enter supermarket. Pick up basket. Pick up vegetables, fruits, meat, milk, eggs. Walk to checkout. Pay. Bag items. Walk out. Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and storing food in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Place bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Place in crisper. Take out meat. Place in freezer. Take out milk. Place in door. Take out eggs. Place in tray. Close refrigerator. Put away bags.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine and folding clean clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up laundry basket. Open washing machine. Put clothes in washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Press start button. Wait for wash cycle. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Place clothes in dryer. Turn on dryer. Wait for dry cycle. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Place folded clothes in basket. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner with the induction cooker while the range hood runs
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Turn on range hood. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up chopsticks. Pick up bowl. Eat food. Drink soup. Pick up plate. Eat vegetables. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up dishes. Walk to sink. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner, washing up and tidying the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up dirty clothes. Place in hamper. Wipe sink with cloth. Wipe counter. Clean mirror with spray. Pick up toilet brush. Clean toilet bowl. Flush toilet. Sweep floor. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Streaming shows on the TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select show. Watch show. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Adjust cushion. Lie down. Watch more shows. Sit up. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and night-time personal care routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone under the bedroom light with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Read articles. Put down phone. Turn off light. Turn off air conditioner. Lie down. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Pull blanket. Sleep.
